family.description: This entry represents a domain found at the N-terminal end of the putative cell signalling protein HAM1 from Cryptococcus neoformans and similar fungal sequences. HAM1 may act as a negative regulator of mating during vegetative growth [[cite:PUB00155454]]. Proteins with this domain often also contain a C-terminal domain [pfam:PF14613].
family.name: HAM1-like, N-terminal domain
